glosses: a hood that attaches to the neck of a cape, overcoat, or religious habit

examples.text: Tom estaba sorprendido de encontrar a María sentada completamente sola en la capilla.
examples.en: Tom was surprised to find Mary sitting all alone in the chapel.

examples.text: La Capilla Sixtina es una extensa capilla construída dentro del Palacio Vaticano en el 1473.
examples.en: The Sistine Chapel is a vast chapel built inside the Vatican Palace in 1473.
